name: Bounty Board
description: Bounties for every player: slay creatures of a faction, gather a material, slay a champion. Build the game's Notice Board in your base (or mark any prop with bounty.mark) and it becomes a Bounty Board: take a bounty there (the host presses E; players who joined get the notices in the chat when they walk up and type /bounty.take), claim the reward there. New notices every 4 in-game days. Quick starters until your first is done; kills by your companion or summons count for you. Kept per world and per player. Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing. A Lua mod: the bounties are a table at the top of main.lua, or your own in emf\config\bounty\pool.lua (kept when EMF is installed again). Installed switched off.
